reviews.text: Called in the morning and they cleared out our entire garage the same day. Fair price, and they swept up after themselves.

reviews.text: After we lost my father, A&H handled his estate cleanout with real respect. Careful with everything, and cheaper than the national chains.

reviews.text: On time, fast, and left the place spotless. The price they gave was the price I paid — no hidden fees.
